name: Jaguar's Pounce
body:
Jaguar's Pounce (Ex)
Source Heroes of Golarion pg. 4
When a slayer with this talent deals sneak attack damage, he can attempt a disarm or trip combat maneuver as an immediate action as if the target were flat-footed (losing its Dexterity bonus to CMD). This combat maneuver does not provoke attacks of opportunity. The slayer must have the jaguar’s grace talent to select this talent.
